text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report responds to an application submitted by the property owner of 101 Drewry Avenue requesting approval for a site-specific Fence Exemption under Section 447-1.2B (1), Section 447-1.2C (1) of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 - Fences. The application relates to an existing and proposed front yard fence and gate system located along the north property line facing Drewry Avenue. North Front Fence Section: Existing concrete piers (columns) and associated fence and gate construction located along the north property line facing Drewry Avenue measure approximately 2.28 metres to 2.41 metres in height from grade, exceeding the maximum permitted height of 1.2 metres.
